Team / Alice —

Initial triage (09:00 PT):
- Telemetry shows a sudden increase in request queueing on the rdx-large-v1.3 pool at the gateway layer; tail latency increased from ~120ms to ~900ms for 95th.
- Error 502s map to an upstream timeout between the gateway and the inference pod during KV cache warm-up on longer prompts.
- No obvious network flapping; host-level CPU/GPU utilization within normal bounds.
- Correlation: a spike in average prompt length from Cedarhaven (longer transcripts) at the same time.

Planned mitigations (in flight):
1) Route Cedarhaven traffic to rdx-large-v1.3-ff (fall-back variant with lower KV overhead) — started at 09:02 PT.
2) Increase per-request timeout at the gateway for the tenant from 3s -> 6s as a temporary tolerance window.
3) Enable prefix-level KV caching and pre-warm the cache for the top 50 prompt prefixes seen in the last 24h.

Attached: runtime-telemetry-20261201.csv (snippet) with request distribution and latency buckets.

I'll monitor and post updates every 10–15 minutes.

—David
